metadata.title: Review and Validate Artifact Updates
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Review applied changes against the approved update plan, assess implementation quality, and perform type-specific structural validation. Goes beyond mechanical checklist verification to evaluate whether changes were implemented in the best possible way. Produces review-report.md for user approval. Use after apply-artifact-updates in the Analyze → Plan → Apply → Review pipeline.

artifactPath.description: Path to the artifact (relative to project root)

output.description: Review report with plan comparison, quality assessment, and structural validation results

prerequisites: apply-artifact-updates step completed (changes applied and recorded in memory)
Memory contains: changesApplied, filesModified, verificationResults from apply step
Memory contains: updatePlanRef (path to update-plan.md) from plan step
Memory contains: artifactType, artifactPath from earlier steps
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: load context → read plan → read artifact → compare against plan → assess quality → validate structure → generate report → present for approval
Plan comparison is mechanical: did the planned changes get applied correctly?
Quality assessment is qualitative: were the changes implemented in the best way?
Structural validation is type-specific: does the artifact conform to its expected structure?
The review-report.md is the approval deliverable — make it clear, actionable, and human-readable
Quality findings MUST include concrete alternatives, not just observations
Do NOT apply fixes in this step — only report findings

read: memory.json (previous steps: updatePlanRef, changesApplied, filesModified, artifactType, artifactPath)
update-plan.md (in process folder, path from memory)
Artifact JSON file (current state after changes)
Artifact MD file (current state after changes)
update: memory.json (current step section with review results)

tools: read_file - Read memory.json, update-plan.md, artifact files
grep - Search for patterns (e.g., step references, naming conventions)
bestPractices: Always load the full context from memory before reviewing — never review in isolation
Compare against the plan's 'after' state, not against what you think it should be
Quality assessment should be constructive: suggest better alternatives, not just criticize
Severity levels matter: don't flag everything as a concern — use suggestion for nice-to-haves, recommendation for should-fix, concern for potential problems
Check consistency with sibling artifacts (e.g., does a template step match how similar steps are structured?)
Structural validation is binary pass/fail; quality assessment is graduated
Self-review the report before presenting — ensure findings are accurate and actionable
When user requests corrections, regenerate only affected report sections

validationChecks: Valid JSON structure with required top-level fields (type, name, metadata, steps, parameters, flow)
steps array present with valid structure (id, number, name, status, stepRef)
Step references use @framework-step:category/name format
Referenced steps exist in .processes/steps/ directory
Parameters defined with required/optional/defaults/definitions
Mermaid diagram in MD is syntactically valid
Mermaid diagram reflects actual step sequence
qualityDimensions: Step descriptions: clear, actionable, not vague
Parameter naming: descriptive, consistent with conventions
Flow logic: logical step sequence, no unnecessary steps
Approval placement: checkpoints at the right moments (after user-facing deliverables)
Consistency with similar templates in the same category

validationChecks: Valid JSON structure with required top-level fields (type, name, category, metadata, output, guidance, substeps, flow, memoryFileUsage, dependencies, references)
substeps array present and numbered sequentially
guidance has specificActions, files, tools, bestPractices
Self-contained: no @framework-step: references in step content
Mermaid diagram in MD matches substep flow
Filename follows kebab-case convention
dependencies and references sections present
qualityDimensions: Substep action specificity: can an agent follow these without ambiguity?
Guidance actionability: are instructions concrete vs. vague?
Best practices relevance: are they specific to this step, not generic filler?
Memory usage: does it make sense for downstream steps that will read this data?
Consistency with sibling steps in the same category

validationChecks: Valid JSON structure with type: process-instance
Step IDs are valid UUIDs
currentState references a valid step ID from the steps array
subProcessState structure is valid (parentProcess, childProcesses, nextSyncPoint)
status is valid enum value
Step numbers are sequential starting from 0
qualityDimensions: Step sequence logic: does the order make sense?
Parameter scoping: are parameters well-defined and not redundant?
State consistency: does currentState reflect actual progress?

qualityAssessmentFramework.description: Framework for evaluating implementation quality beyond mechanical correctness

dimensions.name: Clarity
dimensions.question: Is the implementation easy to understand? Are naming choices clear and consistent?
examples: Vague step description vs. specific one
Ambiguous parameter name vs. descriptive one

dimensions.name: Consistency
dimensions.question: Does the implementation follow established patterns in the codebase?
examples: Sibling steps use a certain structure — does this one match?

dimensions.name: Simplicity
dimensions.question: Could the same result be achieved more simply? Is there over-engineering?
examples: Unnecessary substeps that could be merged

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.question: Does the implementation fully address the intent behind the planned change?
examples: Plan said 'add parameter' but description/defaults are missing
Added field but not used in guidance

dimensions.name: Missed Opportunities
dimensions.question: Are there improvements the plan didn't call for but naturally complement the changes?
examples: Related inconsistency that should be fixed while here

dimensions.name: Best Practices Alignment
dimensions.question: Does the implementation align with framework best practices?

severityLevels.description: Nice-to-have improvement. Not blocking. Implementation is correct but could be slightly better.
severityLevels.action: Include in report. User may optionally address.

severityLevels.description: Should fix. Implementation works but has a meaningful quality gap.
severityLevels.action: Include in report with concrete alternative. Recommend addressing before finalizing.

severityLevels.description: Potential problem. Implementation may cause issues or confusion downstream.
severityLevels.action: Include in report prominently. Strongly recommend addressing.

substeps.name: Init-Step: Confirm Principles
substeps.description: Recall operating principles before starting this step
actions: Read `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md` and recall all principles
Output: '✓ Principles confirmed for this step'

substeps.name: Load Context from Memory
substeps.description: Get required references from prior steps in memory
actions: Read memory.json to get references from prior steps:
- updatePlanRef (path to approved update-plan.md) from plan step
- changesApplied, filesModified, verificationResults from apply step
- artifactType, artifactPath, artifactName from analysis step
Verify all required references are present
If missing, log error to log.json and stop

substeps.name: Read Update Plan
substeps.description: Parse the approved update plan into a list of expected changes
actions: Read update-plan.md using updatePlanRef from memory
Parse the 'Detailed Changes' section into a structured list
Each change: description, target file (JSON or MD), before state, after state
Log: 'Loaded {count} planned changes from update-plan.md'

substeps.name: Read Current Artifact Files
substeps.description: Read the current state of modified artifact files
actions: Based on artifactType, resolve file paths using artifactTypeConfig
Read the artifact JSON file (current state after apply step)
Read the artifact MD file (current state after apply step)
These represent the 'as-implemented' state to compare against the plan

substeps.name: Compare Changes Against Plan
substeps.description: Verify each planned change was applied correctly
actions: For each change in update-plan.md:
- Check if the 'after' state exists in the current artifact
- Categorize: applied (matches plan), missing (not found), partial (present but differs), unplanned (in artifact but not in plan)
Also scan the artifact for any changes not listed in the plan (unplanned changes)
Build structured comparison results with status per change

substeps.name: Assess Implementation Quality
substeps.description: Evaluate whether changes were implemented in the best possible way
actions: For each applied change, evaluate against the quality dimensions:
- Clarity: Easy to understand? Naming choices clear and consistent?
- Consistency: Follows established patterns in the codebase?
- Simplicity: Could the same result be achieved more simply?
- Completeness: Fully addresses the intent, not just the literal plan?
- Missed opportunities: Adjacent improvements that naturally complement the changes?
- Best practices alignment: Framework conventions respected?
Apply type-specific quality checks from artifactTypeConfig.qualityDimensions
For each finding, produce: observation, why it could be improved, concrete alternative, severity (suggestion/recommendation/concern)
Be constructive: suggest better approaches, don't just criticize

substeps.name: Validate Artifact Structure (Type-Specific)
substeps.description: Run structural validation checks based on artifact type
actions: Run all validation checks from artifactTypeConfig.validationChecks for the artifact's type
Each check is binary pass/fail
For failed checks, document: what failed, expected state, actual state, suggested fix
For template: check JSON schema, steps array, step refs exist, params, mermaid syntax, diagram matches steps
For step: check JSON schema, substeps, guidance, self-contained, mermaid, kebab-case, deps/refs
For process: check JSON schema, step UUIDs, currentState, subProcessState, status, sequential numbers

substeps.name: Generate review-report.md
substeps.description: Create comprehensive review report in the process folder
actions: Create review-report.md in the process folder with sections:
- Summary: overall status, artifact reviewed, change count
- Plan Comparison Results: table of each planned change and status (applied/missing/partial/unplanned)
- Unplanned Changes: any modifications not in the plan
- Implementation Quality Assessment: findings per change with severity, observations, concrete suggestions
- Structural Validation Results: table of each check and pass/fail
- Issues Found: detailed description of any failures with suggested fixes
- Recommendation: approve | approve-with-suggestions | fix-required
Update memory.json with reviewReportRef, planComparisonResults, qualityAssessment, structuralValidationResults, overallStatus
Self-review the report before presenting: are findings accurate, actionable, and fairly graded?

substeps.name: Present Report for Approval
substeps.description: Summarize findings and wait for user approval
actions: Present a clear summary: overall status, key findings, quality highlights
Highlight: missing/unplanned changes, recommendations/concerns (not just suggestions), validation failures
Reference the full review-report.md for detailed review
This is the approval checkpoint — wait for user response
If approved: proceed to End-Step
If corrections requested: log feedback, apply corrections to report or re-run affected checks, regenerate report, re-present

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Verify: Do modified process files conform to type definitions? (Principle 7 - see `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md`)
Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Load context → Read plan → Read artifact → Compare against plan → Assess quality → Validate structure → Generate report → Present for approval (loop on corrections) → End

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Previous steps' memory sections (updatePlanRef from plan-artifact-updates, changesApplied/filesModified/verificationResults from apply-artifact-updates, artifactType/artifactPath from analyze-current-artifact-state)
fields: Information Produced: planComparisonResults, qualityAssessment, structuralValidationResults, reviewReportRef, overallStatus
Decisions Made: Overall status determination (approve/approve-with-suggestions/fix-required), quality severity classifications

requiredFiles: update-plan.md (in process folder, path from memory)
